import numpy as np
d=np.loadtxt('shells.tsv',skiprows=1)[:,1:]
x,y=d.T
r=np.corrcoef(x,y)[0,1]
s=np.sign(r)*y.std(ddof=1)/x.std(ddof=1)
b=y.mean()-s*x.mean()
print(s,b,len(x))
import json
json.dump({'status':'completed','results':{'slope':s,'intercept':b,'n':len(x)},'assumptions':[],'exclusions':[],'issues':['Specimen 2 has width > length (17.79 x 18.51), unusual but kept as a valid measurement.'],'summary':'RMA regression of width on length, all 38 specimens, untransformed.'},open('answer.json','w'),indent=1)
"
